content.fact_text: Implementation of the Alerting and Flagging Subsystem for idempotent fraud event generation and high-priority Kafka publication.

provenance_data.behaviour: Provides an idempotent alerting subsystem for flagging suspicious transactions. Uses Redis for deduplication (SETNX with TTL) and Kafka (via KafkaMessagingClient) for high-priority event dispatch. Implements structured logging, performance instrumentation (latency/throughput), and defensive error handling. Dispatches events as signed TransactionFlagged payloads.
interfaces: public static initialize(redis: Redis, kafkaClient: KafkaMessagingClient, metrics: MetricsCollector, config: AlertingConfig): AlertingSubsystem

public async dispatchFlag(transactionId: TransactionId, userId: UserId, merchantId: MerchantId, amount: MonetaryAmount, telemetry: Telemetry, reason: string, riskScore: number, orchestrationVersion: string): Promise<void>
provenance_data.utility: Provides high-performance, idempotent fraud alerting and flagging functionality with built-in instrumentation and Kafka integration.

content.fact_text: Implementation of the EngineCoreOrchestrator for the fraud detection engine, responsible for concurrent rule execution, risk-based threshold evaluation, and downstream flagging dispatch.

provenance_data.behaviour: Provides an asynchronous, non-blocking engine orchestrator for transaction processing. Utilizes Promise.allSettled for concurrent rule evaluation, implements threshold-based risk aggregation, manages idempotency via the AlertingSubsystem, and integrates high-precision telemetry instrumentation. Handles systemic failures gracefully to prevent ingestion pipeline blockage.
interfaces: private async executeRules(transaction: Transaction): Promise<{ successful: RuleResult[], failures: OrchestrationFailure[] }>
private async handleFlagging(transaction: Transaction, riskScore: RiskScore, ruleResults: RuleResult[]): Promise<void>
provenance_data.utility: Engine core orchestrator for high-throughput, fault-tolerant, and observable fraud evaluation pipeline.

provenance_data.utility: Defines the core contracts for the orchestration pipeline, enabling type-safe risk aggregation, alerting, and observability.

content.fact_text: Functional implementation of the RiskAggregator, providing deterministic, weighted risk scoring for transaction evaluation.

provenance_data.behaviour: Aggregates individual fraud rule results into a deterministic RiskScore using a weighted mean algorithm. Includes performance instrumentation for aggregation latency and error logging. Implements defensive normalization to ensure scores stay within the [0.0, 1.0] range. Stateless component.
provenance_data.utility: Computes a deterministic, weighted aggregate risk score essential for fraud detection threshold evaluation.

content.fact_text: Performance Instrumentation Layer for the fraud detection orchestrator. Implements high-precision P95/P99 latency tracking and Prometheus metrics for rules and E2E orchestration pipeline.

provenance_data.behaviour: Provides a singleton-managed, thread-safe performance instrumentation layer using Prometheus. Tracks E2E orchestration latency, per-rule execution timing, error rates, and flagging throughput with high-precision (nanosecond) timers. Employs fail-safe error handling to ensure metrics collection never disrupts the main transaction pipeline.

provenance_data.utility: Provides high-precision performance observability, enabling P95/P99 latency tracking for rule evaluation and end-to-end transaction processing.
